name: Blender
category: A7. Native applications and procedural tools
role: Headless 3D rendering, Python scene build and compositing from the macOS app bundle
summary: Full 3D authoring suite driven in background mode: a .blend file or a Python-built scene renders one frame or a range to PNG or EXR with alpha, under Workbench for speed, EEVEE for real-time quality or Cycles for path tracing. The compositor and simulation caches cover what VCR's own layers cannot yet. Blender keeps its own clock, so frame N is frame N. Its install line and guide assume the macOS app bundle; on Linux use the distro or blender.org build and adjust the path.
use_when: Path-traced product shots, cloth, fluids, particles with baked caches
An existing .blend from a designer must render in a production
Render passes and compositor work before VCR's compositor lands
Over Three.js when minutes per frame are acceptable for the look
avoid_when: Fast iteration on a web-native look: Three.js in seconds
Simple 2D or typography: SVG, GSAP or p5.js
You need a scriptable 2D animation app: Synfig or Manim

facets.one_line: Frame and range renders from the CLI, option ordering, output paths
Factory-settings scenes built in bpy, enums read not guessed, seeds recorded
Node tree by type, render passes to multilayer EXR
Workbench, EEVEE and Cycles: speed, quality and what is byte-stable

notes: Not on PATH on macOS; use the app bundle executable. First native application spike planned in M0.

evidence.result: Workbench background render of one 320x240 RGBA frame from the app bundle
evidence.scope: Backfilled 2026-11-04: Workbench render of one 320x240 RGBA still from the app bundle, macOS arm64; no Cycles, EEVEE, animation or compositing.
